scientific_integrity: All-length finite-state proof with 735-dimensional Cayley-Hamilton reduction and two executable standard-library checks; no claim of independent mathematical verification.
scientific_limitations: Counts distinct one-step indexed cyclic output states of elementary Rule 73 only; a published finite-ring Garden-of-Eden census covers selected small lengths but no all-length formula was found. Does not classify multi-step images, source multiplicities, or general automata. Historical priority qualified by abstract-only access to Kang (2013).
title: Exact cyclic one-step image series of elementary cellular automaton Rule 73
